about: IN-6 flow goldens on ci/fixtures/in-company (CY 2025), worked by hand from the fixture table. KPI-on case: the group sets up GRI + BRSR and selects GHG_SCOPE1, GHG_SCOPE2_LB, ENERGY_TOTAL and WATER_WITHDRAWAL for company 901, with approved 2025 GHG values equal to the fixture's per-site Scope 1 and Scope 2 (data/kpi/mappings.json gives the disclosures).

kpi_off.working: site 901 S1 900 S2 360 S3 400; 902 460 / 220; 903 230 / 100. Scope totals 1,590 / 680 / 400 = the categories Stationary Combustion (1), Purchased Electricity (2), Business Travel (3); renewable electricity (no scope) is not a category link.

kpi_on.working: Scope 1 in = 900 + 460 + 230 = 1,590 = the GHG_SCOPE1 figure (sum over sites) out; Scope 2 680 = GHG_SCOPE2_LB. Scope 3 has no GHG KPI selected: 400 t in, nothing out. ENERGY_TOTAL is count-only (no tonnes). WATER_WITHDRAWAL isn't a climate/energy KPI: not shown. Disclosures (GRI 2021+, BRSR 2023; ESRS not enabled): GHG_SCOPE1 → GRI 305-1, BRSR P6-E7; GHG_SCOPE2_LB → GRI 305-2, BRSR P6-E7; ENERGY_TOTAL → GRI 302-1, BRSR P6-E1: 6 count links, 5 disclosure nodes (P6-E7 takes two).
kpi_on.site_links: the kpi_off case's site → scope links (the same rows)
